about: Raw stderr bytes, colour codes kept, captured on 2026-10-17 for the stated-reason rule (gateStatedReason). Every entry was captured from the real tool at the version named; none is constructed. The absolute path of the scratch repository in the vault-guard error line, and of the scratch directory in the osv-scanner lines, is replaced with <repo>, the only edit. See tests/fixtures/README.md.

gitleaks-8.30.1-rename-limit.how: gitleaks git with conductor's own flags over a repository with diff.renameLimit set to 1 and six files renamed with a change, so git skips exhaustive rename detection. Captured at exit 0; the stated-reason tests use the same bytes as the stderr of a gate that could not run.
